result.title: Cross-Scale Sparse Attention for Referring Segmentation in Remote Sensing
result.summary: High-resolution remote sensing (RS) imagery provides fine spatial detail over large areas, making it essential for fine-grained scene understanding. Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) aims to segment regions described by natural language, yet many existing methods rely on sequential alignment--fusion pipelines with limited joint modeling of cross-scale visual hierarchies and linguistic dependencies. Moreover, dense attention mechanisms struggle with the sparsity and wide spatial dispersion of RS targets, while current datasets offer limited structured evaluation of multi-target references, multi-hop relational reasoning, and multi-granularity descriptions, limiting both model development and evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a Cross-Scale Sparse Attention Model (CSSAM), which aligns multiscale visual features with complex referring expressions through two key modules. The Cross-scale Modality-aligned Fusion Module (CMFM) performs unified cross-scale cross-modal fusion, while the Dynamic Multimodal Sparse Hybrid Attention (DMSHA) selectively attends to informative visual--textual tokens, reducing dense visual interactions. Furthermore, we introduce M$^{3}$RRSIS-D, a RRSIS dataset explicitly designed around three core reasoning dimensions: multi-target (M$^{1}$), reference-dependent multi-hop (M$^{2}$), and multi-granularity (M$^{3}$) expressions. Extensive experiments on M$^{3}$RRSIS-D and two public RRSIS benchmarks demonstrate that CSSAM achieves competitive performance across accuracy, fine-grained reasoning, and high-IoU localization metrics, validating its effectiveness for complex semantic reasoning in realistic RS scenarios. Code, dataset, and model weights will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向遥感指代图像分割（RRSIS），提出 CSSAM：用跨尺度模态对齐融合模块统一多尺度视觉与语言特征，并用动态多模态稀疏混合注意力只关注信息量高的图文 token，以减少稠密视觉交互；同时构建 M³RRSIS-D 数据集，按多目标、依赖指代的多跳关系、多粒度描述三个维度评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其动态稀疏注意力对图文 token 的选择性关注，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与计算/关注分配提供可核查线索，M³ 的多跳关系与多粒度设置也可供推理难度评估参考；但该方法输出分割结果而非 latent 推理状态，与主线联系间接。
